messages:
alert-bot: INCIDENT: High error rate detected for hosted-api (us-east-1). 5m 5xx rate = 4.2% (> 3% SLO). 429 spike preceding 5xx. Paging SRE oncall.

tess (oncall): on it. looking at grafana now. any idea which route?

alex (infra): dashboards show a big bump on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. 429s spiked ~6m ago then backend 502/504s follow.

leo (eng-runtime): i just pushed a rate-limit rollout (quota-aggregator v2) 7m ago to roll up per-tenant burst behavior. rolling policy id 0xC11. can revert if that's the cause.

maya (product-ops): support is already seeing customer tickets for Chatly and FinX about request timeouts. estimated affected tenants ~12, top 3 account for ~60% of traffic.

priya (sre): logs indicate a cascade: quota enforcement returns 429 -> client retries -> queueing -> backend overload -> 502. sample from api-proxy logs: 
```
2026-06-05T15:09:12Z proxy-01  tenant=finx  action=rate_limit  code=429  rule=0xC11
2026-06-05T15:10:01Z proxy-03  tenant=finx  upstream=runtime-2  error=timeout  code=504
```

jordan (support): customers reporting higher error surfaces since ~15:05 UTC. one enterprise customer opened high-priority ticket.

tess (oncall): clear hypothesis: new quota-aggregator behavior is too aggressive leading to retry storms. leo, can you revert v2 rollout now?

leo (eng-runtime): doing rollback now. ETA ~90s. running: `kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/quota-aggregator quota-agg:v1.9.3` and disabling the new cascade flag: `--enable-aggregate-burst=false`

alert-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollback job started by leo at 15:12:23 UTC.

priya (sre): i'm going to add a temporary retry-window backoff in the gateway: set Retry-After header and drop automatic retries at the client proxy for 429s. applying patch to proxy config.

alex (infra): also adding an emergency rule to exclude healthchecks and internal monitor traffic from quota count to reduce noise. patching rate-limiter config in consul.

maya (product-ops): notifying affected accounts that we're mitigating, asking for any logs they can share.

alert-bot: ROLLBACK: quota-aggregator v1.9.3 restored at 15:14:10 UTC.

priya (sre): metrics: 5xx trending down. 5m 5xx = 1.1% at 15:20 UTC. 429s reduced. still watching.

jordan (support): customer update sent to FinX + Chatly saying we're mitigated and collecting additional logs.

leo (eng-runtime): follow-up: the v2 change unintentionally double-counted cross-route bursts for multi-tenant proxies. we missed a guard in the rollout. opening PR to add a progressive weighting and per-tenant cap.

tess (oncall): good work. i'm going to keep pager open for 1 hour to validate stability. handoff note: if it reappears escalate to infra lead (alex) and platform PM (maya).

maya (product-ops): will prepare an incident bulletin and coordinate postmortem. prioritize adding a canary window for future quota changes.

priya (sre): adding remediation checklist to incident tracker: rollback rule, disable aggressive aggregation, set proxy retry behaviour, notify top-affected tenants, schedule postmortem.

alert-bot: NOTE: pager duty notified secondary oncall at 15:30 UTC for handoff.

tess (oncall): handing off to alex for long tail monitoring at 15:40 UTC. alex, you have the pager.

alex (infra): acknowledged. will monitor for next 3h and run a targeted capacity bump if any tenant starts exceeding safe thresholds. also will coordinate quota rollout re-test with canary traffic.

jordan (support): customers confirm error rates dropped, one enterprise still seeing 1% error but reduced.

priya (sre): closing incident thread once metrics stable for 30m. creating postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-0612.

maya (product-ops): note for postmortem: communication latency to customers was ~8-12m, consider automating initial customer-facing status message on high-error triggers.

alert-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: reduction under threshold at 15:50 UTC. follow-up actions assigned.
